sentence: No confirmed narrowband carrier is found: of 56 threshold crossings 18 are attributable to molecular lines and the 31 remaining unattributed ones are consistent with the 24.6 predicted by the fields' own control positions (P = 0.13), while none of the 33 testable crossings recurred -- setting a typical single-epoch completeness limit of 1.5e15 W EIRP for the median system, and coverage limits the search: 21 systems have no repeat epoch at a covered frequency, where no depth of observation could have produced a confirmation.
